## Checklist

- [ ] `npm run verify` passes locally
- [ ] UI matches its `design/*.dc.html` artboard at desktop and at 390px, in light and dark (screenshots below)
- [ ] New or changed pages have one `h1`, a unique title (≤ 60 chars) and description (50–160 chars) — `npm run check:seo`
- [ ] Content schema and `public/admin/config.yml` changed together, if either changed
- [ ] `firebase.json` CSP still covers every script and form target (`npm run check:csp`)
- [ ] A changed or removed URL has a 301 in `firebase.json`
- [ ] No secrets, tokens or personal data in the diff
